# foreman_webhook (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_webhook" "build_notify" {
  name = "Build entered notification"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the webhook to look up.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `event` (String)
- `http_content_type` (String)
- `http_headers` (String)
- `http_method` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `proxy_authorization` (Boolean)
- `ssl_ca_certs` (String)
- `target_url` (String)
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean)
- `webhook_template_id` (Number)
